test.title: Mini-test · Moving to a new city

paragraphs.text: Moving to a new city is exciting, but most people underestimate how tiring the first months can be. Everything, from shopping to finding a doctor, takes longer than it did at home.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: If possible, visit the city before you move. Spending a weekend in different neighbourhoods will help you decide where you would actually like to live.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Rents vary widely between areas. Flats near the centre cost more, but cheaper areas may mean long, expensive journeys, so compare the total cost and not just the rent.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Register with a local doctor as soon as you arrive. Many surgeries have waiting lists, and you do not want to discover this when you are already ill.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Learning the public transport system early saves both time and money. Most cities offer weekly or monthly passes that are much cheaper than buying single tickets.
paragraphs.label: E

paragraphs.text: Loneliness is common in the first year. Joining a club, a sports team or a language class is one of the easiest ways to meet people with similar interests.
paragraphs.label: F

paragraphs.text: Keep in touch with friends and family at home, but not so often that you avoid building a new life. A weekly call is usually enough.
paragraphs.label: G

paragraphs.text: Explore the city as a visitor would. Museums, markets and walking tours help you understand its history and make it feel less strange.
paragraphs.label: H

paragraphs.text: Do not be surprised if you feel homesick after a few weeks. This is a normal reaction once the excitement of the move has worn off, and it usually passes.
paragraphs.label: I

paragraphs.text: Finally, give yourself time. Most people say it takes about a year before a new city truly feels like home.
paragraphs.label: J

document.title: Mini-test · Moving to a new city

items.quote: most people underestimate how tiring the first months can be

explanation.en: “how tiring the first months can be” — everything takes longer → v “A tiring start”.
explanation.kk: «how tiring the first months can be» — бәрі көп уақыт алады → v «A tiring start».
explanation.ru: «how tiring the first months can be» — всё занимает больше времени → v «A tiring start».

items.quote: visit the city before you move
keywords: visit the city before you move

explanation.en: Paragraph B advises a trip first: “visit the city before you move” to choose an area → i “Seeing the city before you move”.
explanation.kk: B абзацының ұсынысы — қалаға алдын ала бару: «visit the city before you move», ауданды таңдау үшін → i «Seeing the city before you move».
explanation.ru: Совет абзаца B — съездить в город заранее: «visit the city before you move», чтобы выбрать район → i «Seeing the city before you move».

items.quote: so compare the total cost and not just the rent

explanation.en: Rent and travel together: “compare the total cost and not just the rent” → iv. Expensive journeys are mentioned, but the topic is housing cost, not transport (viii).
explanation.kk: Жалдау ақысы мен жол бірге: «compare the total cost and not just the rent» → iv. Қымбат жол аталады, бірақ тақырып көлік (viii) емес, тұрғын үй құны.
explanation.ru: Аренда и дорога вместе: «compare the total cost and not just the rent» → iv. Дорогие поездки упомянуты, но тема — стоимость жилья, а не транспорт (viii).

items.quote: Register with a local doctor as soon as you arrive

explanation.en: Paragraph D says to sign up with a doctor at once: “Register with a local doctor as soon as you arrive”, since there are waiting lists → vi “Health care comes first”.
explanation.kk: D абзацы дәрігерге бірден тіркелуді ұсынады: «Register with a local doctor as soon as you arrive», себебі кезек ұзақ → vi «Health care comes first».
explanation.ru: Абзац D советует сразу записаться к врачу: «Register with a local doctor as soon as you arrive», потому что очереди длинные → vi «Health care comes first».

items.quote: Most cities offer weekly or monthly passes that are much cheaper than buying single tickets

explanation.en: Paragraph E is about transport: passes are “much cheaper than buying single tickets” → viii “Getting around cheaply”.
explanation.kk: E абзацы көлік туралы: жол жүру билеттері «much cheaper than buying single tickets», ақша үнемдейді → viii «Getting around cheaply».
explanation.ru: Абзац E о транспорте: проездные «much cheaper than buying single tickets» экономят деньги → viii «Getting around cheaply».

items.quote: one of the easiest ways to meet people with similar interests

explanation.en: Loneliness and ways to meet people → iii “Finding company”.
explanation.kk: Жалғыздық және адамдармен танысу жолдары → iii «Finding company».
explanation.ru: Одиночество и способы познакомиться с людьми → iii «Finding company».

items.quote: but not so often that you avoid building a new life

explanation.en: Keep in touch with home, “but not so often that you avoid building a new life” — balancing old and new → vii.
explanation.kk: Үймен байланыс, «but not so often that you avoid building a new life» — ескі мен жаңаның тепе-теңдігі → vii.
explanation.ru: Общаться с домом, «but not so often that you avoid building a new life» — баланс старого и нового → vii.

items.quote: Explore the city as a visitor would.

explanation.en: “Explore the city as a visitor would” — museums, markets, tours → x “Discovering the city like a tourist”.
explanation.kk: «Explore the city as a visitor would» — мұражай, базар, экскурсия → x «Discovering the city like a tourist».
explanation.ru: «Explore the city as a visitor would» — музеи, рынки, экскурсии → x «Discovering the city like a tourist».

items.quote: This is a normal reaction once the excitement of the move has worn off, and it usually passes

explanation.en: Homesickness is “a normal reaction”, and “it usually passes” → ix “A natural feeling that fades”.
explanation.kk: Үйді сағыну — «a normal reaction», әрі «it usually passes» → ix «A natural feeling that fades».
explanation.ru: Тоска по дому — «a normal reaction», и «it usually passes» → ix «A natural feeling that fades».

explanation.en: “give yourself time” — a city feels like home after about a year → ii “Being patient with yourself”.
explanation.kk: «give yourself time» — қала шамамен бір жылда үйге айналады → ii «Being patient with yourself».
explanation.ru: «give yourself time» — город станет домом примерно через год → ii «Being patient with yourself».
